headline: Kyrgyzstan has produced more than 880 million chicken eggs since the beginning of the year
summary: Egg production in Kyrgyzstan reached 886.4 million units over ten months, according to the National Statistics Committee. Output rose 20.8 percent.
why: Egg production is a measure of agricultural output in an economy and feeds domestic food supply and small-scale farm incomes. Official statistics help gauge sector growth.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане произвели более 880 миллионов куриных яиц с начала года
